name: Futala Lake
hint: Stand anywhere on the northern promenade. The food stalls open around six and the whole kerb lights up.

name: Ambazari Lake
hint: The garden gate on the eastern side is the easiest way in.

name: Deekshabhoomi
hint: The white dome is visible long before you arrive. Aim for the main entrance off the ring road.

name: Zero Mile Stone
hint: A sandstone pillar and four horses, tucked beside the road near the GPO.

name: Sitabuldi Fort
hint: On the hill above the market. Open to visitors only on selected days.

name: Maharajbagh Zoo
hint: The botanical garden entrance, opposite the agricultural college.

name: Raman Science Centre
hint: Look for the dome. The forecourt counts, you do not need a ticket.

name: Seminary Hills
hint: Anywhere along the top road. Best at first light.

name: Telankhedi Garden
hint: Behind the Hanuman temple, above Futala.

name: IIIT Nagpur
hint: The far one. Out past Butibori, and worth the ride.
